name: next-up
description: When a turn ends, suggests up to three next prompts from the conversation, your open GitHub issues and pull requests, or your Linear issues.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Where the steps come from: "mixed" (default) continues the current work and draws on GitHub and Linear; "linear" or "github" only suggests that source's open items; "conversation" only continues the current work. "/next mode <name>" changes it until changed again.

githubItems.title: GitHub items
githubItems.description: Open issues and pull requests (default), or issues only.

linearServer.title: Linear server
linearServer.description: The Linear MCP server's name as /mcp lists it. Empty (default): tries "claude.ai Linear", "Linear" and "linear".

linearProject.title: Linear project
linearProject.description: Only issues in this Linear project (name, identifier or slug). Empty (default): all your open issues.

ranker.title: Ranker
ranker.description: "light" (default): a small model reads the last exchange and the open items, never the transcript. "fork": the session's own model reads the whole cached transcript; better context, larger requests. Fork falls back to light when it does not answer.

rankerModel.title: Light ranker model
rankerModel.description: The model the light ranker uses: an alias such as "haiku" (default) or a full model id.

perSource.title: Items per source
perSource.description: At most this many open items from each source go to the ranker, newest first (default 12, at most 50).
